detail.name: Norma's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Norma's Mindscape: Natural-Born Villain Paradox
detail.desc2:
A business card bearing the image of Norma, Chief Technician of the External Strategy Department.
Specially designed for high-ranking department officials, the card's elaborate decorative patterns also function as physical watermarks. Yet the space intended for a serious professional photo is instead covered with playful Bangboo scribbles.
